tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga bya tshul mdor bsdus snying por dril ba phan bde'i utpal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// jo bo lugs// ༄༅// gang mtshan dran pa'i mod nyid nas// 'jigs pa kun las dbugs 'byin pa'i// myur ma dpa' mor gus btud nas// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// de la 'dir blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba na/ lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas srung ba'i slad du rje btsun sgrol ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing*/ gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na// zhes pa'i man ngag phyogs gcig pa maṇḍal bzhi pa'i mchod pa nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ rten gyi gang zag rgyud dag pa'i dge slong bzhis btang na'ang shin tu bzang ste/ ma grub na rang gcig pus kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang gnas gtsang zhing yid dang mthun la bkod pas mdzes par/ dkon mchog gi rten gsum ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ khyad par rje btsun ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs rab gnas dang ldan pa'i spyan sngar/ stegs kyi khar dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal re khā gnyis skor du bris pa'i dbus su tshom bu bdun bkod pa bzhi dang*/ gtor ma 'bul na zlum gtor bzhi'am gcig mchod pa sna lnga tshar lnga sogs ji ltar 'dzom pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pas 'du byas nas/ cho ga dngos la'ang sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis chab blangs pa'i rjes stan bde ba la 'dug ste dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul thams cad mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la zhes sogs skyabs sems ji ltar rigs par bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnas dang yo byad rnams la dmigs te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir 'khor yug gis gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa'i dbus su mchod rdzas rnams 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ spro na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyang 'don/ dngos gzhi ni/ mdun gyi rten rnams rje btsun sgrol ma la 'khor sgrol ma nyer gcig dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos pas/ maṇḍal dang po dkon mchog spyi la 'bul ba ni/ thog mar/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku zhes sogs shlo ka gcig dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs shlo ka gsum rnams lan gsum du brjod cing shlo ka re la phyag re byas mthar me tog 'thor nas stan la bsdad/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs mas skyabs sems lan gsum byas pas bdag gzhan rnams dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud par bsam/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram zhes sogs kyis maṇḍal phul/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho thugs rje can// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// zhes sogs nas/

yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab/ de nas rje btsun ma la maṇḍal gsum 'bul ba'i dang po ni/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis zhes sogs lan bdun gyis phyag byas la me tog 'thor/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram sogs kyis maṇḍal 'bul/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i skyabs sems lan gsum du byas pas rang dang bsgrub bya thams cad rje btsun ma'i phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin brkyangs pa'i 'og tu tshud nas 'jigs pa thams cad las dbugs dbyung bar bsams la/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa tshar gnyis 'don mthar/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can zhes sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin du maṇḍal gnyis pa la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gsum dang*/ gsum pa la bdun spar ba ma gtogs gzhan 'dra/ mthar/ lha mo la gus sogs phan yon kyang don yid la dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas tshar gcig bya/ rjes ni/ gtor ma 'bul bar spro na skabs 'dir gzhan nas 'byung ba'i cho gas gtang*/ ma 'byor na'ang gzhung rtsa bar mi 'byung bas chad skyon med/ gang ltar yang gtang rag gi slad du yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi mthar/ bag med spyod pa ma dag pas// cho ga gzhung bzhin ma lcogs dang*// lhag chad 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// thugs rjes bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsams la/ su pra tiṣṭhas me tog 'thor/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas zhes sogs kyis dge ba bsngo zhing 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i lta bas rgyas gdab/ bdag gis tshe rabs sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha// zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/

las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de la spyir rje btsun sgrol ma ni rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las thugs rje'i gzugs su shar ba yin pas/ 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon klu sgrub sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyis 'di kho na la thugs dam du mdzad pas bar chad las skyabs pa sogs gtam rgyud shin tu mang la/ khyad par maṇḍal gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di nyid byin rlabs ches myur bas/ gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgyud la skye ba dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub pa po'i gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i slad du gsol ba gdab cing*/ dus rtag tu rje btsun ma dran par byas na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal gyis 'byor pa ni nges pa'o// rje btsun myur ma dpa' mo'i zhabs// mchod pa'i thabs tshul dpyid dpal gyis// phan bde'i utpal rgyas pa'i phul// 'gro rnams nyer 'tsho'i slad gyur cig /ces pa'ang lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan a ti sha nas rim par brgyud pa'i man ngag dpal snar thang pa'i mkhan po mchims ston nam mkha' grags kyis gsal bar mdzad pa'i dgongs don ji lta ba la/ skabs su bab pa'i mtshams sbyor cung zad dang bcas te shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyis shākya'i dge slong bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
